observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black console standing vertically with the PlayStation logo visible on the side panel.
A faint purple light is visible on the top edge of the console in photo 0, which could be a standby or power indicator, but no screen/menu is shown.
Photo 1 shows the opposite side of the same console, revealing a disc slot, indicating this is the disc edition.
One white DualSense-style controller is shown in both photos.
A coiled black cable, wrapped in plastic, is visible in both photos; it appears to be a power cable, not clearly an HDMI cable.
No FIFA disc, game case, box, or additional accessories (second controller, HDMI cable, stand) are visible in either photo.
Glossy black panel in photo 1 shows visible scuff/scratch marks and smudges.
No close-up of serial number, model sticker, or a screen showing the PS5 home menu is provided.
